section.div: PowerNPU: Fast On-device LLM Inference with NPUs [ASPLOS‘25]
Fast Multimodal LLM on Mobile Devices
Cross-engine on-device LLM benchmark — llama.cpp, ExecuTorch, LiteRT-LM, GENIE-X on the same model/prompt/device. Powers pocketpal.dev/leaderboard/engines.
Helpful tools and examples for working with flex-attention
